basic_info.description: 1080 Chestnut Street embodies the best of Russian Hill a prestigious address where timeless elegance meets the lively charm of San Francisco living. This full-service cooperative offers the ease of a doorman, secure parking, and immediate access to the city's most scenic walks. Just steps from the Hyde Street cable cars, Polk Street's vibrant dining and boutiques, and the sparkling waterfront, the location blends classic appeal with everyday convenience. A short stroll also brings you to North Beach, Fort Mason, Ghirardelli Square, Aquatic Park, and the Marina Green some of the city's most beloved landmarks.    The residence is a spacious one-bedroom, one-and-a-half bath retreat featuring a grand living space and an oversized private patio perfect for entertaining or pets with serene outlooks of the Bay, Alcatraz, and the Golden Gate Bridge from the rear of the property. With seamless indoor-outdoor flow and a vibe that balances sophistication with comfort, it's equally suited as a full-time city home or a chic pied--terre stylish, effortless, and endlessly inviting.
